figures.shows: A time axis with steps at 0, 16.7 and 33.3 ms, a frame at 37.5 ms, the drawn time at 20.8 ms, and three lanes: a body blended between 0.100 m and 0.200 m and drawn at 0.125 m, its child light composed at 0.625 m, and a teleported crate drawn exactly at its world pose
figures.caption: The frame is drawn one step behind the clock, a quarter of the way between the two poses.
figures.alt: A horizontal time axis with three step marks and two dashed vertical lines, one for the clock and one for the drawn time, which lies a quarter of the way between the last two steps. Below it, three lanes show a body drawn between its two poses, its child light drawn from its parent, and a teleported crate drawn where it is.
figures.numbers: t from 0 to 50 ms; steps at 0, 16.7 and 33.3 ms (T = 33.3); clock 37.5 ms; accumulator 4.2 ms; drawn time 20.8 ms; alpha 0.25; body poses 0.100 m (from, 16.7 ms) and 0.200 m (to, 33.3 ms), drawn 0.125 m; light local offset 0.5 m, drawn 0.625 m; crate teleported at step 2 to 5.0 m, drawn there.

figures.shows: The position of the toy's body at the 12 frames of the toy program, as a staircase without interpolation and as a straight climb with it, over 120 ms with one slow frame of 40 ms
figures.caption: Without interpolation the position is a staircase; with it the climb is straight and one step behind.
figures.alt: A graph of position in metres against time in milliseconds. A red line climbs in stairs of 0.1 metres with flat parts between, and one stair of 0.2 metres at the slow frame. A blue line climbs steadily slightly below the stairs, with one long straight stretch where a slow frame was drawn.
